revisions.deer: Use case: stylized-concept. Original NoteTatCa sprite atlas of an adorable young woodland DEER FAWN with a tan coat, small white forehead spots, large broad deer ears and tiny rounded antler buds, cream muzzle and chest. Cute polished softly shaded chibi illustration, expressive eyes with catchlights and warm outlines. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: draw each complete bust SMALL in its cell: the ENTIRE silhouette including widest ears/antlers/hair/bun/goggles occupies at most55% of cell width and65% of cell height. At least20% transparent margin on BOTH left and right and15% above EVERY sprite. SMALL ears/antlers/bun/hair must remain whole, never cut, never touch a cell edge. This deliberately uses smaller sprites with lots of empty space for subsequent normalization. Exactly SIX equal columns, THREE equal rows,18 cells. Background actual transparent alpha, no background objects, no checkerboard. Body is IDENTICAL front-facing small bust in all18cells, narrow shoulders, neck centered, straight baseline at85% of cellheight. LEFT THREE COLUMNS row1 head looks up-left/up/up-right,row2 left/center/right,row3 down-left/down/down-right. RIGHT THREE COLUMNS row1 blink/affection small heart/sparkle eyes,row2 surprised/wink/bashful,row3 sleepy/dizzy/delighted. Only head and facial expression change; body NEVER rotates. Preserve character identity, color, hairstyle and clothing across all18sprites. All hair or head accessories stay above shoulders. Do not enlarge sprites to fill cells. All 18 silhouettes fully separated by generous transparent padding. No text, labels, grid, watermark, props, moving arms or ground shadows.
